description: This file defines an interface (IWarningReportingMedia) for warning reporting media within the WPEFramework's WarningReporting namespace. It declares a virtual destructor and a pure virtual method Output for reporting warnings, and includes licensing information.

classes.name: IWarningReportingMedia
classes.description: An interface for warning reporting media, providing a method to output warning information.

methods.name: Output
methods.description: A pure virtual function to output warning information, including filename, line number, identifier, and warning event details.
